name: Bribes
overview: Scripture sternly warns against the corrupting influence of bribes, showing that accepting gifts can blind even the wise and pervert righteous judgment, as seen in Exodus 23:8 and Deuteronomy 16:19. The Proverbs highlight the destructive nature of greed and bribery, revealing that those who covet gain through gifts bring trouble upon themselves, while hating gifts leads to life (Proverbs 15:27). Furthermore, secret gifts can pacify anger but also distort justice (Proverbs 21:14; 17:23), and Ecclesiastes 7:7 emphasizes that gifts can harden the heart and provoke folly in the wise. Together, these verses affirm that bribes undermine integrity and true wisdom, calling believers to reject such practices to uphold righteousness.
